display_long_description:
Inner Focus® offers a new way to support wellness. Through an interactive series of steps, you are guided into a relaxed state that improves focus and reduces stress or anxiety.

Against a backdrop of scenes from nature, each phase is designed to deepen the user’s sense of peace.
— FLOW lets the emotions out through actions assembling mandala puzzles.
— FOCUS is less active. Focus on the circle with your gaze and breathe consciously
— REFLECT is listening. Focus on the sounds around you and the feelings inside you.

By tracking movements, Inner Focus measures how focused you are during each phase, which contributes to a “score” at the end of the experience, with tips to help improved performance.​

Support your wellness in VR:
• Discover over 15 mandalas of different shape and difficulty
• Customize breath patterns and session duration
• Get personalized tips with a smart tracking system
• See historical statistics
• Enjoy your state in a world created with love and care.
